data.title: 毒蛇 · 盛夏泳池畔的水果冰棒
data.description: 高空奢华度假酒店无边泳池旁，毒蛇身穿甜美可爱的粉红条纹挂脖比基尼坐在池边白瓷台阶上，双腿荡在碧蓝池水中。粉色波浪长发湿润披肩，她一手轻举着红色的草莓冰棒，微咬着下唇，翡翠绿眸波光粼粼地斜睨镜头，散发出元气满满又极尽诱惑的夏日小恶魔光芒。
data.action: sitting on white tiled edge of luxury pool, pink striped halter bikini, biting red popsicle with flirty gaze, wet pink wavy hair, emerald eyes shining with playful seduction
data.location: rooftop infinity pool deck with sun loungers under clear summer sky
data.lighting: dazzling summer sunlight reflecting crystal ripples onto fair skin and pink bikini
data.mood: sun-soaked playful tease, irresistible mischievous allure
data.promptProse: Sitting on the edge of a sunlit infinity pool dipping bare feet in water, Viper wears a pink striped halter bikini. Holding a red popsicle to her lips, her wavy pink hair flutters as she winks with dangerous, playful charm.
data.animaCaption: Viper sitting on a pool edge in a pink bikini holding a popsicle, winking flirtatiously.
